source_manifest.evaluation: complete public small and large validation, same logged day; separate screened sensitivity cohort
source_manifest.training: released MIND-small neural weights with random internal 5% validation and sampled training negatives; static local model uses all MIND-small training impressions; Switch additionally uses delayed MIND-small same-day evidence
source_manifest.lt_user_transfer: LSTUR uses publisher account embeddings on small; large transfer uses zero long-term state because there is no verified cross-release account-ID mapping

ensemble_rules.Neural-9: equal mean over the three family ensemble scores
ensemble_rules.NoStream: static four neural checkpoints and the six-input local model, original uncapped local profiles
ensemble_rules.NoStream50: same fusion as NoStream, six-input model refitted and scored with at most 50 history clicks
ensemble_rules.Matched50: same as NoStream50, local ranker and article counts only use the publisher's 149,117 fitting impressions
ensemble_rules.Switch: stored frozen policy ranks, with delayed within-day MIND-small feedback

source_manifest.intervals: normal 95% paired intervals clustered by public account; pointwise, conditional on fitted models and on the logged day
